product: World leading dedicated foundry: 2nm (3% of Q2-2026 wafer revenue), 3nm (30%), 5nm (33%), 7nm (11%), advanced nodes 77%; plus CoWoS/3DFabric advanced packaging and next nodes A16 and 1.4nm in development.
demand: AI and HPC led. Management cites continued strong demand for leading-edge processes; HPC about 55% of revenue; FY26 revenue growth guided above 40% in USD; August 2026 revenue hit a record NT$514.8B, up 53.3% YoY.
pricing_power: Strong. Gross margin 67.7% in Q2-2026; the CFO did not rule out price hikes (2026-09-22); reports of 3-6% wafer price increases locked in for 2027 (2026-09-24); customers such as AMD pass costs through.
competition: TSMC holds about 72.5% of the foundry market (2026-09-22, aggregator). Main challengers are Samsung Foundry and Intel Foundry; Intel may build up to 90% of Nova Lake compute tiles on its 18A node, trimming TSMC planned role (TrendForce 2026-07-15).
team: Chairman and CEO C.C. Wei; CFO Wendell Huang; a Co-COO publicly cautious on AI enthusiasm (Bloomberg 2026-09-15); deputy spokesperson Nina Kao.
market_strategy: Capacity led: 2026 capex USD 60-64B, nine new fabs and packaging plants, Arizona rising to USD 265B across 10 fabs, two advanced packaging plants and an R&D center (2026-07-16), plus Japan and Germany (ESMC on track, 2026-09-15).
bull: Q2-2026 revenue USD 40.20B +33.7% YoY, EPS +77.4%, gross margin 67.7%; August revenue record NT$514.8B +53.3% YoY; FY26 growth guided above 40%; 3-6% 2027 wafer price hikes reported (2026-09-24).
bear: CFO guided Q3 gross margin down to 65-67% on 2nm and overseas-fab dilution; Co-COO cautioned on AI hype (2026-09-15); top-10 customers 76% of revenue; mean target upside is perverse per §17.
falsifier: Q3-2026 gross margin reported below 65% on 2026-10-15, or September monthly sales (2026-10-08) showing YoY growth decelerating below 30%.
web_what_changed: Last 90 days: Q2-2026 record results (revenue USD 40.20B, +33.7% YoY; EPS NT$27.25, +77.4%) on 2026-07-16, same day 2026 capex guidance raised to USD 60-64B and FY26 growth guidance to over 40%; Arizona pledge raised by USD 100B to USD 265B; August revenue record NT$514.8B, +53.3% YoY (2026-09-10).
web_not_known_yesterday: Freshest dated item: on 2026-09-24 DigiTimes and Benzinga reported TSMC locked in 3-6% wafer price hikes for 2027, advanced nodes leading; the CFO had not ruled out hikes (2026-09-22). On 2026-09-23 Synopsys, Cadence and Siemens expanded TSMC design and IP partnerships. All aggregator-sourced.
web_demand_price_volume_mix: Demand plus mix. Q2-2026 USD revenue rose 33.7% YoY (primary) on AI and HPC demand; 2nm was 3% of wafer revenue, 3nm 30%, 5nm 33%, advanced nodes 77% (primary). Price is a small but emerging lever: reported 3-6% 2027 wafer hikes (aggregator).
web_suppliers: Not found in primary filings. Aggregators say CoWoS advanced packaging is the binding constraint, booked solid, with Nvidia holding roughly 60% of that capacity; TSMC is adding packaging capacity (Kaohsiung validation hub, TrendForce 2026-09-21) with upstream tool and substrate supply named in wires (ASML, 2026-09-20). Aggregator only.
web_customers: Highly concentrated. TSMC 2024 annual report: top 10 customers 76% of net revenue; largest 22%, second 12%. Nvidia is expected to overtake Apple as largest customer in 2026 at about 22% versus Apple about 18% (CNBC 2026-01-26); HPC was 55% of revenue.
web_who_loses: Rivals lose share: TSMC holds about 72.5% of the foundry market (Barchart 2026-09-22, aggregator); Samsung Foundry and Intel Foundry are the challengers. Customers absorb price hikes, e.g. AMD told partners of a 10% price rise tied to TSMC wafer costs (2026-09-17, aggregator).
web_contradicting_evidence: Primary: the CFO guided Q3 gross margin down to 65-67% from 67.7%, citing 3-4% dilution from the 2nm ramp plus 2-3% (later 3-4%) overseas-fab dilution. A Co-COO publicly cautioned on AI hype, calling it a three-year-old Superman (Bloomberg 2026-09-15); shares fell 3.3% on the 2028 roadmap (2026-09-14).
web_if_management_right: Q3-2026 revenue lands at USD 44.6-45.8B, up about 37% YoY, on the 2nm ramp; FY26 growth exceeds 40% in USD; capex of USD 60-64B converts into 2027 capacity, with reported 2027 capex near USD 85B (2026-08-20); analyst mean target USD 552.26 implies about 22% upside.
web_if_management_wrong: Margins break first. If 2nm and overseas-fab dilution exceed guidance and 2027 price hikes push customers to multi-source, gross margin slides below 65% while the USD 265B Arizona build and record HPC concentration (about 55% of revenue) leave little cushion in an AI demand digestion.
web_second_order_beneficiaries: Equipment and EDA vendors: ASML and Applied Materials (2026-09-20), Synopsys, Cadence and Siemens (2026-09-23) tie to TSMC advanced nodes; UBS sees CoWoS capacity rising to 270 kwpm (2026-09-23); packaging, test and substrate suppliers cluster around Taiwan new packaging parks (Reuters 2026-09-21) and Arizona.
